$comment: Identity is frozen by artifacts/design/rule-catalog-v1.md. interaction.duplicate-component-signals is audit-only by design: it reports an INFERRED signal and never gates validate, because a heuristic that produces a verdict is a false positive with authority.

rules.title: Every meaningful interface state is designed and reachable
rules.description: A view that can be loading, empty, partial, errored, offline, or unauthorized has each of those states designed, not left as whatever the default rendering produces.
rules.rationale: The states nobody designed are the ones users meet on their worst day. An undesigned error state is the interface at the moment it matters most.
rules.remediation: Design each state the view can reach, and record any the project deliberately excludes.
rules.$assuranceNote: A state is established by being driven into it. A run covers the states it provoked; the rest remain unevaluated rather than passing.

rules.title: Empty, filtered-empty, error, and loading are distinguishable
rules.description: Nothing yet, nothing matching your filter, we could not load this, and still loading are presented as four different things.
rules.rationale: Collapsed into one blank panel, they demand four different responses from the user while giving them no way to tell which is required.
rules.remediation: Give each state its own message and its own available action.
rules.$assuranceNote: Whether four states read as four different things to a user is a judgment about presentation, established by review rather than by inspecting the branches.

rules.title: Error classes stay distinguishable in presentation
rules.description: Where the application produces structured errors, the interface uses the class rather than flattening every failure into one generic message, and a caught failure is not discarded to keep the interface clean.
rules.rationale: A validation failure, a permission failure, and an outage need three different responses from the user. Presenting them identically removes the information that would let them respond at all.
rules.remediation: Branch presentation on the error's class, and surface failures rather than swallowing them.
rules.$assuranceNote: Source can show a catch block that discards its error and a handler that ignores an error's class. It cannot establish that every class the application produces has a presentation.

rules.title: Destructive actions are confirmed proportionally to their consequence
rules.description: An irreversible action requires a deliberate confirmation matched to what it destroys, and a reversible one is not made tedious by a confirmation it does not need.
rules.rationale: Confirmation is a budget. Spent on everything, it is read by nobody and the one that mattered is dismissed with the rest.
rules.remediation: Confirm in proportion to consequence, and prefer undo where undo is possible.
rules.$assuranceNote: Proportionality is the whole content of this rule and it is a judgment. A count of confirmation dialogs establishes nothing about it.

rules.title: Repeated implementations of one interaction pattern are surfaced
rules.description: Signals that the same interaction pattern has been implemented several times are reported for a human to judge.
rules.rationale: Duplication is worth seeing and not worth automating a verdict on: whether two similar components should be one is a design decision, and Standard 7 R2 exists because a bad consolidation is worse than the duplication.
rules.remediation: Review the reported signals and consolidate where consolidation produces a better abstraction, not merely a smaller count.
rules.$assuranceNote: Findings are INFERRED and audit-only: they never gate validate. Similar names and shapes are a hint about duplication, not a demonstration of it.
